class.name: Shape3D
class.brief_description: Abstract base class for 3D shapes used for physics collision.
class.description: Abstract base class for all 3D shapes, intended for use in physics. [b]Performance:[/b] Primitive shapes, especially [SphereShape3D], are fast to check collisions against. [ConvexPolygonShape3D] and [HeightMapShape3D] are slower, and [ConcavePolygonShape3D] is the slowest.

method.name: get_debug_mesh
method.description: Returns the [ArrayMesh] used to draw the debug collision for this [Shape3D].
